## Purpose

The substrate every other module is built and shipped on: monorepo layout, reproducible builds, pinned dependencies, CI runners, artifact registry and signing, secret management, and the local Docker Compose environment that makes the whole system reproducible on one machine.

## Depends on

_none — this module is a root of the DAG._

## Depended on by

- [`01-domain-kernel`](01-domain-kernel.md) — Domain Kernel (types + math)

## Inputs

_none declared_

## Outputs

- signed container images
- SBOM
- pinned lockfiles
- dev/test environments

## What gets built

- monorepo + workspace tooling (cargo workspace, pnpm workspace)
- Docker Compose environment with profiles (infra/core/edge/web/obs)
- CI pipeline definitions and the gate runner
- artifact build, SBOM generation, image signing
- secret management and configuration loading
- structured logging, tracing and metrics bootstrap

## Invariants

These are executed as tests at gate **G4**. A module may not declare an
invariant it does not test.

- INV-900: every dependency is pinned and its lockfile committed; a build is reproducible from the commit alone.
- INV-901: no secret is present in a tracked file, and the secret scanner detects a planted canary.
- INV-902: the runtime image runs as a non-root user and carries no shell or package manager.

## Test obligations

- toolchain bootstrap smoke test
- compose up -> all healthchecks green
- secret scanner finds a planted canary secret

## Known failure modes

The things that go wrong in systems like this one. Each should map to a test above.

- unpinned dependency silently changes financial behaviour between builds
- CI green on a stale cache rather than the real tree
